message.content:
The cover of "TEMPO" magazine, edition "11-17 FEBRUARI 2013," features a light blue sky with white clouds as a background. Three men with dark hair and facial hair are illustrated in the foreground.

On the left, a man in a white jacket with a gray collar looks down with a pained expression. To his right, a man in a yellow shirt holds a metal spatula over a red charcoal grill. On the far right, a man in a white apron with a black logo containing a yellow stalk of grain stands with his eyes closed and mouth open. Above him, a piece of brown, cooked meat is positioned in the air.

The grill contains several pieces of grilled meat and a sliced tomato. Below the men, text reads "LUTHFI HASAN ISHAAQ, SUSWONO, DAN ANIS MATTA." Centrally located is the bold black word "HANGUS!" followed by "Sejumlah petinggi PKS terpanggang perkara suap daging impor." Top headlines include "UNDUR-UNDUR ANAS TERSANGKA" and "ANDI ARIEF, MISBAKHUN, DAN PAJAK CIKEAS." A barcode and "RP 29.700" are on the left edge.
